verification: Recursively validate path/bytes/SHA leaves in all loaded current receipts, including external compiler/CUDA tool identities without placing them in Git; explicitly read authoritative helper/build/source, owned compile/link/run/reader calls, exact prepared inputs, per-run completion, GPU actual final completion and full257-row pair CSV/JSON. original_gates: Single-run native clocks/IDs/no-exclusion/schema/ledger/energy/CFL/dterror and nonemptyJ are retained. Independent halves use5Pa/.005mm plus normalizedp/v/u1e-4. Backend cross uses only5Pa/.005mm hard bounds; normalized cross, passive density and weak continuum remain descriptive. Explicit double casts prevent PowerShell5 Decimal-vs-Double false metadata rejection.
failures_retained_not_admitted: Debug/Release r1 actual helper C2668 ADL compile errors, exact ownedexit2; r2 qualification repair does not alter physics
CPU_c_r2 pre-native -omp:4 parser rejection, exact ownedexit1; r3 uses actual -ompthreads:4 without rerunning a completed solve
whitelist: Only this actual-stage author scripts/notes, r1 failures/r2 inputs/helpers/r3 owned run+review records, native textual completions/history/IDs, runtime XML and four pair PNG/CSV/JSON, plus exactly notes/upl_gpu_k0_actual_root_review_r3.json and parent examples/Hydromechanic coupling/validation/upl_current_status.json authorized by root. No production source change or unrelated previous-stage evidence is added. Both r1 and r2 publisher author files are retained. Manifest has precise git_paths including itself but does not attempt an impossible self-SHA.
independent_review_attribution: Root review note records the separately reported peer checks and the root's four PNG inspections. Publisher binds that note without inventing a new peer machine PASS or claiming to run the peer audit.
authority: No Git commands, build commands, physical program invocations, notifications or scheduling exist in the publisher. Author does not execute it. Root later reviews the new manifest and independently owns any selective Git actions.
limits: Bounded constant-k=0 private GPU/CPU agreement, not public GPU, nonzero-k Darcy, general boundary, full-cycle physical release, exact restart or general conservation acceptance.
